trap.label: get round to
trap.wrong: I will get round of the report tomorrow.
trap.right: I will get round to the report tomorrow.
trap.why: Em português “arranjar tempo de” leva de. Em inglês, get round to + substantivo/-ing.

mcq.q: Wild yeast needs a feeding schedule: “get the hang of it” means you...

fix.wrong: He got the hang to the bread.
fix.right: He got the hang of the bread.

fix.wrong: I’ll get round to bake it.
fix.right: I’ll get round to baking it.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com get across: “She managed to explain her idea.”
Reescreva com get round to: “I will find time to feed the yeast.”
rewrite.answer: I will get round to feeding the yeast.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com get the hang of: “He learned how to shape loaves.”
rewrite.answer: He got the hang of shaping loaves.
